description:
[Admin] Last step of start_media_upload: checks the stored file and makes it usable. A file that is not what was declared, a video that is not H.264, or an SVG with anything active is removed and the error says why. Check `replaced` when replacing a file.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

duration_seconds.description: Length of a video or audio file in seconds.

height.description: Height in pixels of an image or video.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

poster_url.description: Still image shown before a video plays: the `url` of an image in this company's library.

width.description: Width in pixels of an image or video.

name: finish_media_upload
title: Finish a media upload
